<\STATESEP>section\<open>Increment and Decrement Machine Words Without Wrap-Around\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory Next_and_Prev
imports
  Aligned
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lift_definition word_next :: \<open>'a::len word \<Rightarrow> 'a word\<close>
  is \<open>\<lambda>k. if 2 ^ LENGTH('a) dvd k + 1 then - 1 else k + 1\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<And>int1 int2. take_bit LENGTH('a) int1 = take_bit LENGTH('a) int2 \<Longrightarrow> take_bit LENGTH('a) (if 2 ^ LENGTH('a) dvd int1 + 1 then - 1 else int1 + 1) = take_bit LENGTH('a) (if 2 ^ LENGTH('a) dvd int2 + 1 then - 1 else int2 + 1)<\STATESEP>by (simp flip: take_bit_eq_0_iff) (metis take_bit_add)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lift_definition word_prev :: \<open>'a::len word \<Rightarrow> 'a word\<close>
  is \<open>\<lambda>k. if 2 ^ LENGTH('a) dvd k then 0 else k - 1\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<And>int1 int2. take_bit LENGTH('a) int1 = take_bit LENGTH('a) int2 \<Longrightarrow> take_bit LENGTH('a) (if 2 ^ LENGTH('a) dvd int1 then 0 else int1 - 1) = take_bit LENGTH('a) (if 2 ^ LENGTH('a) dvd int2 then 0 else int2 - 1)<\STATESEP>by (simp flip: take_bit_eq_0_iff) (metis take_bit_diff)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma word_next_unfold:
  \<open>word_next w = (if w = - 1 then - 1 else w + 1)\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. word_next w = (if w = - 1 then - 1 else w + 1)<\STATESEP>by transfer (simp flip: take_bit_eq_mask_iff_exp_dvd)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma word_prev_unfold:
  \<open>word_prev w = (if w = 0 then 0 else w - 1)\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. word_prev w = (if w = 0 then 0 else w - 1)<\STATESEP>by transfer (simp flip: take_bit_eq_0_iff)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma [code]:
  \<open>Word.the_int (word_next w :: 'a::len word) =
    (if w = - 1 then Word.the_int w else Word.the_int w + 1)\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. Word.the_int (word_next w) = (if w = - 1 then Word.the_int w else Word.the_int w + 1)<\STATESEP>by transfer
    (simp add: mask_eq_exp_minus_1 take_bit_incr_eq flip: take_bit_eq_mask_iff_exp_dvd)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma [code]:
  \<open>Word.the_int (word_prev w :: 'a::len word) =
    (if w = 0 then Word.the_int w else Word.the_int w - 1)\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. Word.the_int (word_prev w) = (if w = 0 then Word.the_int w else Word.the_int w - 1)<\STATESEP>by transfer (simp add: take_bit_eq_0_iff take_bit_decr_eq)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma word_adjacent_union:
  "word_next e = s' \<Longrightarrow> s \<le> e \<Longrightarrow> s' \<le> e' \<Longrightarrow> {s..e} \<union> {s'..e'} = {s .. e'}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<lbrakk>word_next e = s'; s \<le> e; s' \<le> e'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> {s..e} \<union> {s'..e'} = {s..e'}<\STATESEP>apply (simp add: word_next_unfold ivl_disj_un_two_touch split: if_splits)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<lbrakk>s \<le> e; s' \<le> e'; e \<noteq> - 1; e + 1 = s'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> {s..e} \<union> {s'..e'} = {s..e'}<\STATESEP>apply (drule sym)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<lbrakk>s \<le> e; s' \<le> e'; e \<noteq> - 1; s' = e + 1\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> {s..e} \<union> {s'..e'} = {s..e'}<\STATESEP>apply simp<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<lbrakk>s \<le> e; e + 1 \<le> e'; e \<noteq> - 1; s' = e + 1\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> {s..e} \<union> {e + 1..e'} = {s..e'}<\STATESEP>apply (subst word_atLeastLessThan_Suc_atLeastAtMost_union)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (4 subgoals):
 1. \<lbrakk>s \<le> e; e + 1 \<le> e'; e \<noteq> - 1; s' = e + 1\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> e \<noteq> - 1
 2. \<lbrakk>s \<le> e; e + 1 \<le> e'; e \<noteq> - 1; s' = e + 1\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> s \<le> e
 3. \<lbrakk>s \<le> e; e + 1 \<le> e'; e \<noteq> - 1; s' = e + 1\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> e \<le> e'
 4. \<lbrakk>s \<le> e; e + 1 \<le> e'; e \<noteq> - 1; s' = e + 1\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> {s..e'} = {s..e'}<\STATESEP>apply (simp_all add: word_Suc_le)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal:
No subgoals!<\STATESEP>done<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
